name: site-search-indexer
title: Site Search Indexer & Custom Search Migration Bridge
description: Build a domain-scoped, structured-content search index from llms.txt manifests, sitemaps, and page metadata. Returns clean JSON for site search and RAG pipelines.

inputSchema.title: Site Search Indexer input
inputSchema.description: Index publicly accessible, domain-scoped pages using publisher-provided manifests and structured metadata.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: One or more pages or site roots to index. All discovered links must remain on the same hostname as a start URL.
startUrls.sectionDescription: The Actor checks llms.txt / llms-full.txt, sitemap.xml, and supplied pages. It never uses search-engine SERP pages.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: Hard cap on unique pages fetched across all start URLs.
maxPages.sectionDescription: Requests are sequential and domain-scoped. Raise limits carefully for large sites.

includeContent.title: Include readable page content
includeContent.description: Extract a bounded plain-text passage from each supported HTML, Markdown, or plain-text resource.

maxContentChars.title: Maximum content characters per page
maxContentChars.description: Maximum extracted text characters stored per page when readable content is enabled.

changeMode.title: Indexing mode
changeMode.description: Full emits all successfully indexed pages. Changes emits only new or changed pages when a previous index is supplied.

previousIndexUrl.title: Previous index JSON URL
previousIndexUrl.description: Optional publicly accessible JSON array (or { items: [...] }) from a prior run. Used to compare content hashes in Changes mode.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout applied to each manifest, sitemap, previous-index, and page request.

userAgent.title: HTTP User-Agent
userAgent.description: Identify your client when fetching publisher-hosted resources. Follow each site's published terms and robots policy.
